messages:
mia-sales: Heads up — OrangeBank POC asks for EU-only residency. They want data-at-rest + in-transit to remain in eu-west-1, no automatic failover to US, and BYOK via customer HSM. Need confirmation on allowed subprocessors, control-plane routing, and pricing impact. Can @sam-presales / @oliver-oncall / @lexi-security confirm? 

sam-presales: I can take presales. Quick clarifying qs: 1) Control plane must be EU as well or just the data plane? 2) Are they expecting HA across EU regions (eu-west-1 + eu-west-2) or strictly single-region?

lexi-security: From the security side: they insisted control-plane signaling stay in EU and audit logs retained in EU for 7 years. BYOK via external HSM (customer-managed CloudHSM or HSM appliance) — that requires Private/Dedicated. Hosted API cannot host customer HSM keys. Will need subprocessor attestation for any edge/relay providers.

oliver-oncall: Ops note: we can do tenant pinning and regional-only routing, but that requires Dedicated capacity or Private deployment. Our standard hosted plan routes control plane through us-east by default, so it won't meet their requirement. For HA, we can configure sticky-routing within EU only (failover to another EU AZ/region), but if they forbid any cross-border failover we need to disable cross-region fallback. Also need IP allowlist + peering details from their networking team.

sam-presales: Summary for customer Qs: confirm (A) control plane in EU? (B) acceptable EU fallback (e.g., eu-west-1 -> eu-west-2) or strictly single-region? (C) will they provide CloudHSM/KMS in their account? Once they confirm, we'll propose Dedicated monthly commit or Private bundle.

lexi-security: Subprocessors we currently use (EU-facing for this stack): AWS (eu-west-1), FastEdge Relay (EU POPs), Sentry (EU datacenter), Datadog (EU). I'll attach legal subproc attestation doc to the ticket. If OrangeBank needs an exhaustive list for contract, we need to escalate to Legal.

oliver-oncall: Runbook snippet to pin tenant routing (example config):
```yaml
route_policy:
  tenant_pin: true
  allowed_regions:
    - eu-west-1
  fallback_policy: restricted
  restricted_fallback: []  # empty => no cross-border failover
  kv_cache_policy: local-only
```
Note: kv_cache local-only increases token latency for cold starts; warn customer.

sam-presales: Pricing/ops impact (ballpark): Dedicated EU-only pool -> baseline +15-30% over mixed-hosted; BYOK/HSM integration -> one-time ops fee ($3k) + $1k/mo for key rotation/audit support depending on scope. Exact numbers after sizing. Egress/cross-region failover changes can also bump network/capacity costs.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-9243 — "OrangeBank EU-only POC: subproc attestation, BYOK, regional pinning". Assigned: sam-presales, oliver-oncall, lexi-security.

mia-sales: Thanks all. I'll ask OrangeBank for answers to your three clarifying Qs and request network diagrams + KMS contact. Proposed next step: schedule tech deep-dive Wed 10:00 CET.

sam-presales: I'll draft the proposal template (Dedicated EU config + BYOK addendum) and share before the deep-dive.

lexi-security: I'll upload SOC2 + subproc list to INF-9243 and note the constraints around hosted vs. private for BYOK.

oliver-oncall: I'll prepare a short ops runbook and request peering checklist from Network Eng. Will also include the exact config diff we need for kv cache / prefix caching to avoid cross-region leakage.

mia-sales: Perfect — action items: sam -> proposal; lexi -> docs; oliver -> ops runbook + peering list. I'll confirm meeting with customer after I get their answers. :thumbsup:
